title: Exercise 6: A Deliberately Flawed Workflow
description: An audit exercise. This workflow is labeled deliberately flawed, and each of its own comments points at a defect for you to find.

steps.description: This is the first of two files in the audit exercise. Line 2 marks it as `DELIBERATELY FLAWED, do not copy`, so the defects are intended, and line 3 starts the `on` block.
`push:` has no branch restriction. Its own comment is the defect note: which branches, since any branch can deploy.
The job runs on `ubuntu-latest`. Its comment is the defect note: there is no environment and no actor check.
The `run` block echoes the token. Its comment is the defect note: it prints the secret past the mask.
The `env` block sets `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN` to a literal value. Its comment is the defect note: a hardcoded secret in the repo.

steps.question: The exercise says the two files together contain how many distinct defects to find?
